$comment: Single source of truth for temidayoafonja.com. Section 25 of the production
reconciliation brief. This file is a record, not a build input: nothing reads it at
runtime, because the site has no build step and netlify.toml publishes the repository
root as-is. Its purpose is to give one authoritative place to check a name, a date, a
price or a claim before publishing it anywhere.
Every value here was read out of the pages in this repository on the revision date
below, not supplied from memory. Where a value is an operator decision that is
deliberately not published, it is recorded with published: false and the reason.
If this file and the live site ever disagree, the live site is what visitors see, and
the disagreement is a defect to report rather than a value to copy from here.

revision.production_note: The container running this verification cannot reach temidayoafonja.com or the Netlify deploy previews; the egress proxy blocks both. Because publish is the repository root and there is no build step, the repository is the deployed artifact byte for byte, but the live site has not been checked directly.

approved_claims.prohibited_wording_correction: An earlier draft of this file listed the bare term 'Institutional Resilience' as prohibited. That was wrong, and the live site is what corrected it. The term is current framework vocabulary on /framework; what was retired is the causal construction, where the two readings were said to produce it. The corrected copy states that the readings inform it, that neither one produces it, and that the four terms are not a causal sequence.
